description:
# DH-04 | Fun 002 | Approvals & CRO Summary

**📋 Ticket:** [DH - DealRoom contract analysis](https://brightdata-group.monday.com/boards/8667788707/views/224418520/pulses/12251055162)
**🔗 Board:** brightdata-group.monday.com/boards/8667788707

---

**TRIGGER:** Function call (after legal analysis) with `contract_id`

**PURPOSE:** Builds the CRO sign-off message — combines DealHub commercial data + Salesforce approvals + DH-03 legal analysis.

**FLOW:**
1. Fetch DealHub quote (SF quote_id + `external_identifier_flag`)
2. Parse quote (products, discounts, approvals, finance, legal config, submitted_by)
3. JOIN `legal_terms` + `contract_registry` (one query → legal + account/opportunity/quote_url)
4. Build CRO message (2-col meta grid, product table, approval trail, finance, legal high-risk bullets, SFDC links, "view thread")
5. Post to CRO (Gunja) DM with ✅ Approve / ❌ Reject buttons

**BUTTONS:** fire DH-05 (approve) / DH-06 (reject)
**DB:** reads `legal_terms` + `contract_registry`

input.code:
require 'json'

r = input['response'] || input['body'] || input
r = JSON.parse(r) if r.is_a?(String)
r ||= {}

answers    = r['answers'] || []
approvals  = r['approvals'] || []
summary    = r['summary'] || {}
info       = r['info'] || {}
line_items = r['line_items'] || []
deal_room  = r['deal_room_info'] || {}

find_ans = lambda do |qid|
  a = answers.find { |x| x['question_id'] == qid }
  a ? a['answer'].to_s.gsub(/\A"|"\z/, '').strip : nil
end

commercial = {
  'product_family'     => find_ans.call('Product_Family'),
  'proxy_products'     => find_ans.call('Proxy_Products'),
  'data_products'      => find_ans.call('Web_Data_Products'),
  'dataset_name'       => find_ans.call('Dataset_Name_Question'),
  'dataset_type'       => find_ans.call('Dataset_Type'),
  'record_count'       => find_ans.call('Record_Count'),
  'units'              => find_ans.call('Units'),
  'residential_discount'=> find_ans.call('Residential_Global_Discount'),
  'commitment_type'    => find_ans.call('Final_Commitment_Type'),
  'change_commitment'  => find_ans.call('Change_Commitment'),
  'duration_months'    => find_ans.call('Duration'),
  'billing_terms'      => find_ans.call('General_Billing_Terms'),
  'owner_rank'         => find_ans.call('SFDC_Owenr_Rank'),
  'managed_services'   => find_ans.call('General_Question_For_Manage_Services'),
  'price_change_reason'=> find_ans.call('Reason_for_price_change')
}

finance = {
  'current_credit_days'   => find_ans.call('Payment_Terms'),
  'final_credit_days'     => find_ans.call('Final_Payment_Terms'),
  'change_payment_terms'  => find_ans.call('Change_Payment_Terms'),
  'payment_type'          => find_ans.call('Payment_Type'),
  'pre_paid'              => find_ans.call('Pre_Paid'),
  'credit_low_risk'       => find_ans.call('isCredit_Low_Risk'),
  'credit_max_debt_flag'  => find_ans.call('isCredit_Max_Debt'),
  'change_credit_max_debt'=> find_ans.call('Change_Credit_Max_Debt'),
  'current_credit_max_debt'=> find_ans.call('Current_Credit_Max_Debt'),
  'final_credit_max_debt' => find_ans.call('Final_Credit_Max_Debt'),
  'add_credits'           => find_ans.call('Add_Credits'),
  'installments'          => find_ans.call('Installments'),
  'commitment_type_fin'   => find_ans.call('Commitment_Type_2')
}

legal = {
  'contract_type'      => find_ans.call('MSA_Type'),
  'auto_renew'         => find_ans.call('Auto_Renew'),
  'termination_type'   => find_ans.call('Termination_Type'),
  'logo_permission'    => find_ans.call('Marketing_Logo_Permission'),
  'required_signature' => find_ans.call('isRequiredSignature'),
  'no_cancellation'    => find_ans.call('No_Cancellation_Clause'),
  'effective_date'     => find_ans.call('Effctive_Date')
}

products = line_items.map do |li|
  {
    'name'       => li['name'],
    'list_price' => li['list_price'],
    'net_price'  => li['net_price'],
    'discount'   => li['sales_discount']
  }
end

real_lines = line_items.select { |li| li['net_price'].to_f > 1.0 }
real_msrp  = real_lines.sum { |li| li['list_price'].to_f }
real_net   = real_lines.sum { |li| li['net_price'].to_f }
real_discount_pct = real_msrp > 0 ? ((real_msrp - real_net) / real_msrp * 100).round(2) : 0

categorize = lambda do |reason|
  rr = reason.downcase
  if rr =~ /discount|rvp|marketplace|unlocker|deal approval|insights|managed servi/
    'COMMERCIAL'
  elsif rr =~ /commitment|installment|credit|payment|finance|flexible/
    'FINANCE'
  elsif rr =~ /legal|contract|msa/
    'LEGAL'
  else
    'OTHER'
  end
end

norm = approvals.map do |a|
  reason = a['reason'].is_a?(Array) ? a['reason'].join('; ') : a['reason'].to_s
  cm = a['reviewer_comment'].to_s
  cm = '' if cm == 'null' || cm.downcase == 'automatically approved as one of a group'
  # clean HTML tags + entities from comment
  cm = cm.gsub(/<br\s*\/?>/i, ' ').gsub(/<[^>]+>/, '').gsub('&', '&').gsub(' ', ' ').strip
  {
    'reviewer'    => a['reviewer'].to_s,
    'step'        => a['step'],
    'reason'      => reason,
    'status'      => a['status'].to_s,
    'review_date' => a['review_date'].to_s,
    'comment'     => cm
  }
end

by_reason = {}
norm.each do |a|
  k = a['reason']
  if by_reason[k].nil?
    by_reason[k] = a.merge('group' => categorize.call(a['reason']), 'all_reviewers' => [a['reviewer']])
  else
    by_reason[k]['all_reviewers'] << a['reviewer']
    if by_reason[k]['comment'].to_s.empty? && !a['comment'].to_s.empty?
      by_reason[k]['comment']  = a['comment']
      by_reason[k]['reviewer'] = a['reviewer']
    end
  end
end
appr = by_reason.values.map { |a| a['all_reviewers'] = a['all_reviewers'].uniq; a }

commercial_approvals = appr.select { |a| a['group'] == 'COMMERCIAL' }
finance_approvals    = appr.select { |a| a['group'] == 'FINANCE' }
legal_approvals      = appr.select { |a| a['group'] == 'LEGAL' }
other_approvals      = appr.select { |a| a['group'] == 'OTHER' }

# legal reviewer short-names (from Legal Approval group)
legal_reviewers = legal_approvals.flat_map { |a| (a['all_reviewers'] || [a['reviewer']]) }
                    .map { |e| e.to_s.split('@').first }.reject(&:empty?).uniq
legal_reviewers_str = legal_reviewers.join(', ')

totals = {
  'currency'          => summary['currency'],
  'total_list_price'  => summary['total_list_price'],
  'total_net_price'   => summary['total_net_price'],
  'blended_discount'  => summary['total_discount'],
  'real_discount_pct' => real_discount_pct
}

{
  'account_name'         => info['account_name'],
  'quote_number'         => info['dealhub_quote_number'],
  'quote_status'         => r['status'],
  'opportunity_id'       => info['external_opportunity_id'],
  'external_quote_id'    => info['external_quote_id'],
  'quote_url'            => info['quote_url'],
  'dealroom_url'         => deal_room['url'],
  'geo_code'             => info['geo_code'],
  'submitted_by'         => info['submitted_by'],
  'created_by'           => info['created_by'],
  'commercial'           => commercial,
  'finance'              => finance,
  'legal'                => legal,
  'products'             => products,
  'commercial_approvals' => commercial_approvals,
  'finance_approvals'    => finance_approvals,
  'legal_approvals'      => legal_approvals,
  'other_approvals'      => other_approvals,
  'legal_reviewers'      => legal_reviewers,
  'legal_reviewers_str'  => legal_reviewers_str,
  'approvals_count'      => appr.length,
  'totals'               => totals,
  'commercial_json'          => commercial.to_json,
  'finance_json'             => finance.to_json,
  'legal_json'               => legal.to_json,
  'products_json'            => products.to_json,
  'commercial_approvals_json'=> commercial_approvals.to_json,
  'finance_approvals_json'   => finance_approvals.to_json,
  'legal_approvals_json'     => legal_approvals.to_json,
  'other_approvals_json'     => other_approvals.to_json,
  'totals_json'              => totals.to_json
}

# ---- inputs ----

channel_id   = input['channel_id'].to_s   # <-- Gunja's USER ID (U...) for a DM

commercial = JSON.parse(input['commercial_json'].to_s) rescue {}
finance    = JSON.parse(input['finance_json'].to_s)    rescue {}
legal_cfg  = JSON.parse(input['legal_json'].to_s)       rescue {}
products   = JSON.parse(input['products_json'].to_s)    rescue []

l_appr     = JSON.parse(input['legal_approvals_json'].to_s)      rescue []
o_appr     = JSON.parse(input['other_approvals_json'].to_s)      rescue []

# ---- legal analysis (from legal_terms) ----
is_customized = input['is_customized'].to_s == 'true'
dev_count     = input['deviation_count'].to_s
risk          = input['highest_risk_level'].to_s
legal_summary = input['legal_summary'].to_s

# ---- helpers ----
blank = lambda { |v| v.nil? || v.to_s.strip.empty? || v.to_s.downcase == 'null' }
money = lambda do |v|
  n = v.to_f
  '$' + n.round(0).to_s.reverse.gsub(/(\d{3})(?=\d)/, '\\1,').reverse
end
short_email = lambda { |e| e.to_s.split('@').first }

currency = totals['currency'].to_s
currency = 'USD' if currency.empty?
net_total = totals['total_net_price'].to_f
real_disc = totals['real_discount_pct']

won      = quote_status.downcase.include?('won')
appr_all = c_appr + f_appr + l_appr + o_appr
legal_lbl = is_customized ? ":warning: Customized MSA (#{dev_count} deviations)" : ":white_check_mark: Standard MSA"
status_bits = []
status_bits << (won ? ":white_check_mark: Won deal" : "Quote #{quote_status}")
status_bits << legal_lbl
status_bits << "#{appr_all.length} approvals cleared" unless appr_all.empty?
status_bits << "Ready to sign"

blocks = []

# ===== HEADER =====
blocks << { 'type' => 'header',
  'text' => { 'type' => 'plain_text',
    'text' => ":lower_left_fountain_pen: CRO Sign-off — #{customer}  ·  #{money.call(net_total)}", 'emoji' => true } }

blocks << { 'type' => 'section',
  'text' => { 'type' => 'mrkdwn', 'text' => status_bits.join('  ·  ') } }

# ===== META =====
meta = []
meta << { 'type' => 'mrkdwn', 'text' => "*Customer:*\n#{customer}" }
meta << { 'type' => 'mrkdwn', 'text' => "*Quote:*\n#{quote_number}" }
meta << { 'type' => 'mrkdwn', 'text' => "*Value:*\n#{money.call(net_total)} #{currency}" } unless net_total == 0
meta << { 'type' => 'mrkdwn', 'text' => "*Term:*\n#{commercial['duration_months']} mo #{commercial['commitment_type']}" } unless blank.call(commercial['duration_months'])
meta << { 'type' => 'mrkdwn', 'text' => "*Geo:*\n#{geo}" } unless blank.call(geo)
meta << { 'type' => 'mrkdwn', 'text' => "*Owner Rank:*\n#{commercial['owner_rank']}" } unless blank.call(commercial['owner_rank'])
blocks << { 'type' => 'section', 'fields' => meta.first(10) }

blocks << { 'type' => 'divider' }

# ===== PRODUCTS & DISCOUNTS =====
unless products.empty?
  rows = []
  rows << sprintf("%-26s %9s %6s %9s", "Product", "List", "Disc", "Net")
  products.each do |p|
    name = p['name'].to_s[0, 26]
    list = money.call(p['list_price'])
    net  = money.call(p['net_price'])
    disc = p['discount'].nil? ? '' : "#{p['discount'].to_f.round(0)}%"
    rows << sprintf("%-26s %9s %6s %9s", name, list, disc, net)
  end
  rows << ("-" * 52)
  rows << sprintf("%-26s %9s %6s %9s", "TOTAL NET", "", "", money.call(net_total))
  table = "```\n" + rows.join("\n") + "\n```"
  blocks << { 'type' => 'section', 'text' => { 'type' => 'mrkdwn', 'text' => ":shopping_trolley: *PRODUCTS & DISCOUNTS*" } }
  blocks << { 'type' => 'section', 'text' => { 'type' => 'mrkdwn', 'text' => table } }
end

# dataset context
ds_bits = []
ds_bits << commercial['dataset_name']     unless blank.call(commercial['dataset_name'])
ds_bits << commercial['dataset_type']     unless blank.call(commercial['dataset_type'])
ds_bits << "#{commercial['record_count']} records" unless blank.call(commercial['record_count'])
ds_bits << "#{commercial['duration_months']}mo #{commercial['commitment_type']}" unless blank.call(commercial['duration_months'])
ds_bits << "#{real_disc}% real discount" unless blank.call(real_disc)
blocks << { 'type' => 'context', 'elements' => [ { 'type' => 'mrkdwn', 'text' => "*Dataset:* " + ds_bits.join(' · ') } ] } unless ds_bits.empty?

blocks << { 'type' => 'divider' }

# ===== APPROVAL TRAIL =====
fmt_appr = lambda do |a|
  reviewer = short_email.call(a['reviewer'])
  status   = a['status'].to_s
  emoji    = status.downcase.include?('approv') ? ':white_check_mark:' : ':white_circle:'
  date     = a['review_date'].to_s
  date     = date[0, 10] unless date.empty?
  line = "#{emoji} *#{a['reason']}*"
  line += " — #{reviewer}" unless reviewer.empty?
  line += " · #{date}" unless date.empty?
  line += "\n     :speech_balloon: \"#{a['comment']}\"" unless a['comment'].to_s.strip.empty?
  co = (a['all_reviewers'] || []).map { |r| short_email.call(r) }.reject { |r| r.empty? || r == reviewer }.uniq
  line += "\n     :busts_in_silhouette: co-approved: #{co.join(', ')}" unless co.empty?
  line
end

enrich_commercial = lambda do |a|
  base = fmt_appr.call(a)
  r = a['reason'].to_s.downcase
  extra = []
  if r.include?('discount')
    charged = products.select { |p| p['net_price'].to_f > 1.0 }
    top = charged.max_by { |p| p['discount'].to_f }
    extra << "#{top['discount'].to_f.round(0)}% on #{top['name']} (net #{money.call(top['net_price'])})" if top
  end
  if r.include?('rvp') || r.include?('marketplace')
    thr = net_total >= 10000 ? "#{money.call(net_total)} one-time ≥ $10k" : "MRR threshold met"
    extra << "deal size: #{thr}"
  end
  extra.empty? ? base : base + "\n     :heavy_dollar_sign: " + extra.join(' · ')
end

enrich_finance = lambda do |a|
  base = fmt_appr.call(a)
  r = a['reason'].to_s.downcase
  extra = []
  extra << "installments: #{finance['installments']}" if r.include?('installment') && !blank.call(finance['installments'])
  extra << "credit days: #{finance['current_credit_days']} → #{finance['final_credit_days']}" if (r.include?('credit day') || r.include?('payment')) && !blank.call(finance['final_credit_days'])
  extra << "max debt: #{finance['current_credit_max_debt']} → #{finance['final_credit_max_debt']}" if r.include?('debt') && !blank.call(finance['final_credit_max_debt'])
  extra << "low-risk amount: #{finance['final_credit_max_debt']}" if r.include?('low risk') && !blank.call(finance['final_credit_max_debt'])
  extra.empty? ? base : base + "\n     :heavy_dollar_sign: " + extra.join(' · ')
end

appr_txt = ":clipboard: *APPROVAL TRAIL*\n"

unless c_appr.empty?
  appr_txt += "\n:shopping_trolley: *Commercial*\n"
  appr_txt += c_appr.map { |a| enrich_commercial.call(a) }.join("\n") + "\n"
end

if f_appr.empty?
  fin_bits = []
  fin_bits << commercial['commitment_type'] unless blank.call(commercial['commitment_type'])
  fin_bits << finance['payment_type']        unless blank.call(finance['payment_type'])
  fin_bits << 'prepaid'                       if ['yes','true'].include?(finance['pre_paid'].to_s.downcase)
  fin_bits << 'no credit changes'
  appr_txt += "\n:moneybag: *Finance*\n#{fin_bits.reject{|x| blank.call(x)}.join(' · ')}\n"
else
  appr_txt += "\n:moneybag: *Finance*\n"
  appr_txt += f_appr.map { |a| enrich_finance.call(a) }.join("\n") + "\n"
end

appr_txt += "\n:scales: *Legal*\n"
if is_customized
  appr_txt += ":warning: Customized — #{dev_count} deviations (highest risk: #{risk})\n"
  appr_txt += l_appr.map { |a| fmt_appr.call(a) }.join("\n") + "\n" unless l_appr.empty?
else
  appr_txt += ":white_check_mark: Standard MSA — no deviations\n"
end

unless o_appr.empty?
  appr_txt += "\n:grey_question: *Other*\n"
  appr_txt += o_appr.map { |a| fmt_appr.call(a) }.join("\n") + "\n"
end

appr_txt.scan(/.{1,2900}/m).each { |c| blocks << { 'type' => 'section', 'text' => { 'type' => 'mrkdwn', 'text' => c } } }

if is_customized && !legal_summary.strip.empty?
  blocks << { 'type' => 'section', 'text' => { 'type' => 'mrkdwn', 'text' => ":robot_face: *Legal analysis:*\n#{legal_summary[0,1500]}" } }
end

blocks << { 'type' => 'divider' }

# ===== BUTTONS =====
btn_elems = [
  { 'type' => 'button', 'style' => 'primary',
    'text' => { 'type' => 'plain_text', 'text' => ':white_check_mark: Approve & Sign', 'emoji' => true },
    'action_id' => 'cro_approve', 'value' => contract_id },
  { 'type' => 'button', 'style' => 'danger',
    'text' => { 'type' => 'plain_text', 'text' => ':x: Reject', 'emoji' => true },
    'action_id' => 'cro_reject', 'value' => contract_id }
]
unless dealroom_url.strip.empty?
  btn_elems << { 'type' => 'button',
    'text' => { 'type' => 'plain_text', 'text' => ':link: DealHub', 'emoji' => true },
    'url' => dealroom_url, 'action_id' => 'open_dealhub' }
end
blocks << { 'type' => 'actions', 'elements' => btn_elems }

blocks << { 'type' => 'context', 'elements' => [
  { 'type' => 'mrkdwn', 'text' => ":robot_face: BrightMind · #{quote_number} · awaiting CRO decision · #{contract_id}" } ] }

blocks = blocks.first(50)

# ===== FULL Slack body (channel = Gunja user ID for DM) =====
slack_body = {
  'channel' => channel_id,
  'text'    => "CRO Sign-off — #{customer} · #{money.call(net_total)} · #{quote_number}",
  'blocks'  => blocks
}

{
  'slack_body_json' => slack_body.to_json,
  'channel_id'      => channel_id,
  'contract_id'     => contract_id,
  'customer'        => customer,
  'quote_number'    => quote_number,
  'net_total'       => money.call(net_total),
  'dealroom_url'    => dealroom_url,
  'quote_url'       => quote_url,
  'is_customized'   => is_customized
}

input.code:
require 'json'

contract_id  = input['contract_id'].to_s
customer     = input['account_name'].to_s
quote_number = input['quote_number'].to_s
quote_status = input['quote_status'].to_s
geo          = input['geo_code'].to_s
quote_url    = input['quote_url'].to_s

# ---- SFDC links (computed once) ----
opportunity_id = input['opportunity_id'].to_s
account_id     = input['account_id'].to_s
sfdc_base_url  = input['sfdc_base_url'].to_s
sfdc_base      = sfdc_base_url.strip.sub(/\/+\z/, '')
opp_link_url     = (opportunity_id.strip.empty? || sfdc_base.empty?) ? '' : "#{sfdc_base}/#{opportunity_id}"
account_link_url = (account_id.strip.empty?     || sfdc_base.empty?) ? '' : "#{sfdc_base}/#{account_id}"

commercial = JSON.parse(input['commercial_json'].to_s) rescue {}
finance    = JSON.parse(input['finance_json'].to_s)    rescue {}
legal_cfg  = JSON.parse(input['legal_json'].to_s)       rescue {}
products   = JSON.parse(input['products_json'].to_s)    rescue []
totals     = JSON.parse(input['totals_json'].to_s)      rescue {}
c_appr     = JSON.parse(input['commercial_approvals_json'].to_s) rescue []
f_appr     = JSON.parse(input['finance_approvals_json'].to_s)    rescue []
l_appr     = JSON.parse(input['legal_approvals_json'].to_s)      rescue []
o_appr     = JSON.parse(input['other_approvals_json'].to_s)      rescue []

is_customized  = input['is_customized'].to_s == 'true'
dev_count      = input['deviation_count'].to_s
risk           = input['highest_risk_level'].to_s
legal_summary  = input['legal_summary'].to_s
legal_reviewer = input['legal_reviewer'].to_s

legal_reviewers_str = input['legal_reviewers_str'].to_s
legal_msg_ts     = input['legal_msg_ts'].to_s
legal_channel_id = input['legal_channel_id'].to_s

cro_bullets = JSON.parse(input['cro_high_risk_bullets'].to_s) rescue []
cro_bullets = [] unless cro_bullets.is_a?(Array)

blank = lambda { |v| v.nil? || v.to_s.strip.empty? || v.to_s.downcase == 'null' }
money = lambda do |v|
  n = v.to_f
  '$' + n.round(0).to_s.reverse.gsub(/(\d{3})(?=\d)/, '\\1,').reverse
end
short_email = lambda { |e| e.to_s.split('@').first }

net_total = totals['total_net_price'].to_f
real_disc = totals['real_discount_pct']
currency  = totals['currency'].to_s
currency  = 'USD' if currency.empty?

risk_dot     = risk == 'high' ? ':red_circle:' : (risk == 'medium' ? ':large_orange_circle:' : ':large_green_circle:')
legal_status = is_customized ? ":warning: CUSTOMIZED — Legal reviewed" : ":white_check_mark: Standard MSA"
val_display  = net_total > 0 ? "#{money.call(net_total)} #{currency}" : "Pending Order Form"

# ---- quote status label (Expired = warning) ----
status_label = case quote_status.downcase
               when 'won'                 then ':white_check_mark: Won deal'
               when 'approved'            then ':white_check_mark: Quote Approved'
               when 'expired'             then ':warning: Quote Expired — refresh before signing'
               when 'draft'               then ':pencil2: Quote Draft'
               when 'pending', 'submitted' then ':hourglass_flowing_sand: Quote Pending'
               else                            "Quote #{quote_status}"
               end

# ========== HEADER + STATUS ==========
header_text  = ":lower_left_fountain_pen: *CRO Sign-off — #{customer}  ·  #{money.call(net_total)}*\n\n"
sbits = []
sbits << status_label
sbits << (is_customized ? ":warning: Customized MSA (#{dev_count} deviations)" : ':white_check_mark: Standard MSA')
appr_all = c_appr + f_appr + l_appr + o_appr
sbits << (appr_all.empty? ? 'No approvals on quote' : "#{appr_all.length} approvals cleared")
sbits << 'Ready to sign'
header_text += sbits.join('  ·  ')

# ========== META as LIST (Customer clickable → SFDC Account) ==========
term_val = blank.call(commercial['duration_months']) ? '—' : "#{commercial['duration_months']} mo #{commercial['commitment_type']}"
customer_display = account_link_url.empty? ? customer : "<#{account_link_url}|#{customer}>"

meta_fields = [
  { 'title' => '*Customer:*',   'value' => customer_display },
  { 'title' => '*Quote:*',      'value' => (blank.call(quote_number) ? '—' : quote_number) },
  { 'title' => '*Deal Value:*', 'value' => val_display },
  { 'title' => '*Term:*',       'value' => term_val },
  { 'title' => '*Status:*',     'value' => legal_status },
  { 'title' => '*Owner Rank:*', 'value' => (blank.call(commercial['owner_rank']) ? '—' : commercial['owner_rank'].to_s) },
  { 'title' => '*Geo:*',        'value' => (blank.call(geo) ? '—' : geo) },
  { 'title' => '*Contract:*',   'value' => contract_id }
]

# ========== QUOTE LINK + SFDC OPPORTUNITY ==========
links = []
links << ":link: <#{quote_url}|View full quote in DealHub>" unless blank.call(quote_url)
links << ":bar_chart: <#{opp_link_url}|Opportunity in Salesforce>" unless opp_link_url.empty?
quote_link_text = links.empty? ? ' ' : links.join('  ·  ')

# ========== COMMERCIAL ==========
com = ":shopping_trolley: *COMMERCIAL*\n"
unless products.empty?
  rows = []
  rows << sprintf("%-26s %9s %6s %9s", "Product", "List", "Disc", "Net")
  products.each do |p|
    name = p['name'].to_s[0, 26]
    rows << sprintf("%-26s %9s %6s %9s", name, money.call(p['list_price']),
                    (p['discount'].nil? ? '' : "#{p['discount'].to_f.round(0)}%"), money.call(p['net_price']))
  end
  rows << ("-" * 52)
  rows << sprintf("%-26s %9s %6s %9s", "TOTAL NET", "", "", money.call(net_total))
  com += "```\n" + rows.join("\n") + "\n```\n"
end
ds = []
ds << commercial['dataset_name'] unless blank.call(commercial['dataset_name'])
ds << commercial['dataset_type'] unless blank.call(commercial['dataset_type'])
ds << "#{commercial['record_count']} records" unless blank.call(commercial['record_count'])
ds << "#{commercial['duration_months']}mo #{commercial['commitment_type']}" unless blank.call(commercial['duration_months'])
ds << "#{real_disc}% real discount" unless blank.call(real_disc)
com += "_Dataset: #{ds.join(' · ')}_\n" unless ds.empty?
if c_appr.empty?
  com += "• :grey_question: _No commercial approvals recorded on this quote_\n"
else
  c_appr.each do |a|
    who = short_email.call(a['reviewer'])
    d = a['review_date'].to_s[0,10]
    com += "• :white_check_mark: *#{a['reason']}* — #{who}#{d.empty? ? '' : " · #{d}"}\n"
    com += "     :speech_balloon: \"#{a['comment']}\"\n" unless a['comment'].to_s.strip.empty?
    co = (a['all_reviewers'] || []).map { |r| short_email.call(r) }.reject { |r| r.empty? || r == who }.uniq
    com += "     :busts_in_silhouette: co-approved: #{co.join(', ')}\n" unless co.empty?
    r = a['reason'].to_s.downcase
    if r.include?('discount')
      charged = products.select { |p| p['net_price'].to_f > 1.0 }
      top = charged.max_by { |p| p['discount'].to_f }
      com += "     :heavy_dollar_sign: #{top['discount'].to_f.round(0)}% on #{top['name']} (net #{money.call(top['net_price'])})\n" if top
    end
    if r.include?('rvp') || r.include?('marketplace')
      com += "     :heavy_dollar_sign: deal size: #{money.call(net_total)} one-time ≥ $10k\n" if net_total >= 10000
    end
  end
end
commercial_text = com.rstrip

# ========== FINANCE ==========
fin = ":moneybag: *FINANCE*\n"
finance_line = []
finance_line << "*Commitment:* #{commercial['commitment_type']}" unless blank.call(commercial['commitment_type'])
finance_line << "*Installments:* #{finance['installments']}" unless blank.call(finance['installments'])
finance_line << "*Payment:* #{finance['payment_type']}" unless blank.call(finance['payment_type'])
finance_line << "*Prepaid*" if ['yes','true'].include?(finance['pre_paid'].to_s.downcase)
finance_line << "*Credit days:* #{finance['current_credit_days']} → #{finance['final_credit_days']}" unless blank.call(finance['final_credit_days'])
fin += "• " + finance_line.join("  |  ") + "\n" unless finance_line.empty?
if f_appr.empty?
  fin += "• :grey_question: _No finance approvals recorded on this quote_\n"
else
  f_appr.each do |a|
    who = short_email.call(a['reviewer'])
    fin += "• :white_check_mark: *#{a['reason']}* — #{who}\n"
    fin += "     :speech_balloon: \"#{a['comment']}\"\n" unless a['comment'].to_s.strip.empty?
    r = a['reason'].to_s.downcase
    fin += "     :heavy_dollar_sign: installments: #{finance['installments']}\n" if r.include?('installment') && !blank.call(finance['installments'])
    fin += "     :heavy_dollar_sign: credit days: #{finance['current_credit_days']} → #{finance['final_credit_days']}\n" if (r.include?('credit') || r.include?('payment')) && !blank.call(finance['final_credit_days'])
    fin += "     :heavy_dollar_sign: max debt: #{finance['current_credit_max_debt']} → #{finance['final_credit_max_debt']}\n" if r.include?('debt') && !blank.call(finance['final_credit_max_debt'])
  end
end
finance_text = fin.rstrip

# ========== LEGAL ==========
if is_customized
  legal_text = ":scales: *LEGAL* — #{risk_dot} *CUSTOMIZED, #{dev_count} deviations*\n"

  items = cro_bullets.map { |b| b.to_s.strip }.reject(&:empty?).first(3)

  if items.empty?
    hi = legal_summary[/HIGH-RISK:(.*?)(MEDIUM:|LOW:|$)/im, 1].to_s
    items = hi.split(/;|\n/).map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?).first(3) unless hi.strip.empty?
  end
  if items.empty?
    clauses = legal_summary.scan(/^\s*\d+[\.\)]\s*(.+?)(?=\n\s*\d+[\.\)]|\z)/m).map { |m| m[0].gsub(/\s+/, ' ').strip }
    items = clauses.select { |c| c =~ /high\s*risk/i }.map { |c| c.gsub(/\s*[—\-]?\s*high\s*risk\.?\s*\z/i, '').strip }.first(3)
  end

  if items.any?
    items.each { |it| legal_text += "• :red_circle: #{it[0,160]}\n" }
  else
    first_line = legal_summary.split("\n").map(&:strip).reject(&:empty?).first.to_s
    legal_text += "• :red_circle: #{first_line[0,180]}\n"
  end

  reviewer_display = legal_reviewers_str.strip.empty? ? legal_reviewer : legal_reviewers_str
  legal_text += "• :white_check_mark: Reviewed & approved by Legal#{reviewer_display.strip.empty? ? '' : " (#{reviewer_display})"}\n"

  if legal_msg_ts.strip.empty? || legal_channel_id.strip.empty?
    legal_text += "• :page_facing_up: Full legal analysis → see Legal channel"
  else
    ts_clean = legal_msg_ts.gsub('.', '')
    legal_link = "https://brightdata.slack.com/archives/#{legal_channel_id}/p#{ts_clean}"
    legal_text += "• :page_facing_up: Full legal analysis → <#{legal_link}|view thread>"
  end
else
  legal_text = ":scales: *LEGAL* — :white_check_mark: Standard MSA, no deviations\n"
  legal_text += "• Contract: #{legal_cfg['contract_type']}\n" unless blank.call(legal_cfg['contract_type'])
  legal_text += "• Auto-Renew: #{legal_cfg['auto_renew']} · Termination: #{legal_cfg['termination_type']} · Signature: #{legal_cfg['required_signature']}"
end

footer_text = ":robot_face: Analyzed by BrightMind — CRO sign-off required · #{contract_id}"

{
  'header_text'     => header_text,
  'meta_fields'     => meta_fields,
  'quote_link_text' => quote_link_text,
  'commercial_text' => commercial_text,
  'finance_text'    => finance_text,
  'legal_text'      => legal_text,
  'footer_text'     => footer_text,
  'contract_id'     => contract_id,
  'quote_url'       => quote_url,
  'params_string'   => "contract_id: #{contract_id}"
}

require 'json' require 'securerandom' # ---------- INPUTS ---------- contract_id = input['contract_id'].to_s customer = input['account_name'].to_s quote_number = input['quote_number'].to_s quote_status = input['quote_status'].to_s geo = input['geo_code'].to_s quote_url = input['quote_url'].to_s opportunity_id = input['opportunity_id'].to_s account_id = input['account_id'].to_s sfdc_base = input['sfdc_base_url'].to_s.strip.sub(/\/+\z/, '') opp_link = (opportunity_id.empty? || sfdc_base.empty?) ? '' : "#{sfdc_base}/#{opportunity_id}" acct_link = (account_id.empty? || sfdc_base.empty?) ? '' : "#{sfdc_base}/#{account_id}" # ---------- PER-CONTRACT TOKEN + SECURE LINKS ---------- api_token = input['api_token'].to_s api_base = input['api_base'].to_s.strip.sub(/\/+\z/, '') cro_token = SecureRandom.hex(20) # api_token moved to the END of the URL approve_url = "#{api_base}/approve?contract_id=#{contract_id}&t=#{cro_token}&api_token=#{api_token}" reject_url = "#{api_base}/reject?contract_id=#{contract_id}&t=#{cro_token}&api_token=#{api_token}" commercial = JSON.parse(input['commercial_json'].to_s) rescue {} finance = JSON.parse(input['finance_json'].to_s) rescue {} products = JSON.parse(input['products_json'].to_s) rescue [] totals = JSON.parse(input['totals_json'].to_s) rescue {} is_customized = input['is_customized'].to_s == 'true' dev_count = input['deviation_count'].to_s risk = input['highest_risk_level'].to_s legal_link = input['legal_thread_url'].to_s legal_reviewer = input['legal_reviewers_str'].to_s cro_bullets = JSON.parse(input['cro_high_risk_bullets'].to_s) rescue [] cro_bullets = [] unless cro_bullets.is_a?(Array) # ---------- HELPERS ---------- esc = lambda { |s| s.to_s.gsub('&','&').gsub('<','<').gsub('>','>') } blank = lambda { |v| v.nil? || v.to_s.strip.empty? || v.to_s.downcase == 'null' } money = lambda do |v| '$' + v.to_f.round(0).to_s.reverse.gsub(/(\d{3})(?=\d)/, '\\1,').reverse end md = lambda { |s| esc.call(s).gsub(/\*(.+?)\*/, '\1') } net_total = totals['total_net_price'].to_f currency = totals['currency'].to_s currency = 'USD' if currency.empty? real_disc = totals['real_discount_pct'] status_chip = case quote_status.downcase when 'won', 'approved' then ['#2eb67d', '✅ Quote ' + esc.call(quote_status)] when 'expired' then ['#f2c744', '⚠️ Quote Expired — refresh before signing'] else ['#8a8d98', 'Quote ' + esc.call(quote_status)] end risk_color = risk == 'high' ? '#e01e5a' : (risk == 'medium' ? '#f2c744' : '#2eb67d') legal_hdr = is_customized ? "⚠️ CUSTOMIZED, #{dev_count} deviations" : "✅ Standard MSA, no deviations" # ---------- META ROWS ---------- customer_html = acct_link.empty? ? esc.call(customer) : "#{esc.call(customer)}" term_val = blank.call(commercial['duration_months']) ? '—' : "#{esc.call(commercial['duration_months'])} mo #{esc.call(commercial['commitment_type'])}" meta = [ ['Customer', customer_html], ['Quote', blank.call(quote_number) ? '—' : esc.call(quote_number)], ['Deal Value', net_total > 0 ? "#{money.call(net_total)} #{esc.call(currency)}" : 'Pending Order Form'], ['Term', term_val], ['Status', is_customized ? '⚠️ CUSTOMIZED — Legal reviewed' : '✅ Standard MSA'], ['Owner Rank', blank.call(commercial['owner_rank']) ? '—' : esc.call(commercial['owner_rank'])], ['Geo', blank.call(geo) ? '—' : esc.call(geo)], ['Contract', esc.call(contract_id)] ] meta_html = '' meta.each_slice(2) do |pair| meta_html += '' pair.each do |label, val| meta_html += "#{label}: #{val}" end meta_html += '' if pair.length == 1 meta_html += '' end # ---------- PRODUCT TABLE ---------- rows_html = '' products.each do |p| disc = p['discount'].nil? ? '' : "#{p['discount'].to_f.round(0)}%" rows_html += " #{esc.call(p['name'])} #{money.call(p['list_price'])} #{disc} #{money.call(p['net_price'])} " end ds = [] ds << esc.call(commercial['dataset_name']) unless blank.call(commercial['dataset_name']) ds << "#{esc.call(commercial['duration_months'])}mo #{esc.call(commercial['commitment_type'])}" unless blank.call(commercial['duration_months']) ds << "#{real_disc}% real discount" unless blank.call(real_disc) dataset_line = ds.empty? ? '' : "
#{ds.join(' · ')}
" # ---------- FINANCE ---------- fin_bits = [] fin_bits << "Commitment: #{esc.call(commercial['commitment_type'])}" unless blank.call(commercial['commitment_type']) fin_bits << "Payment: #{esc.call(finance['payment_type'])}" unless blank.call(finance['payment_type']) fin_bits << "Credit days: #{esc.call(finance['current_credit_days'])} → #{esc.call(finance['final_credit_days'])}" unless blank.call(finance['final_credit_days']) finance_html = fin_bits.empty? ? 'No finance changes recorded' : fin_bits.join('  |  ') # ---------- LEGAL BULLETS ---------- legal_html = '' cro_bullets.first(3).each do |b| legal_html += "
🔴 #{md.call(b)}
" end legal_html += "
✅ Reviewed & approved by Legal#{legal_reviewer.strip.empty? ? '' : " (#{esc.call(legal_reviewer)})"}
" unless legal_link.strip.empty? legal_html += "
📄 Full legal analysis → view thread
" end # ---------- LINKS ---------- links = [] links << "🔗 View full quote in DealHub" unless blank.call(quote_url) links << "📊 Opportunity in Salesforce" unless opp_link.empty? links_html = links.join('  ·  ') # ---------- BUILD HTML ---------- html = <<~HTML
brightdata  ·  CRO Sign-off — #{esc.call(customer)} · #{money.call(net_total)}
#{status_chip[1]}  ·  #{is_customized ? "⚠️ Customized MSA (#{dev_count} deviations)" : '✅ Standard MSA'}  ·  Ready to sign
#{meta_html}
#{links_html}
🛒 COMMERCIAL
#{rows_html}
Product List Disc Net
TOTAL NET #{money.call(net_total)}
#{dataset_line}
💰 FINANCE
#{finance_html}
⚖️ LEGAL — #{legal_hdr}
#{legal_html}
✅ Approve ❌ Reject
You can also action this from Slack — both stay in sync.
🤖 Analyzed by BrightMind — CRO sign-off required · #{esc.call(contract_id)}
HTML { 'email_html' => html, 'email_subject' => "CRO Sign-off — #{customer} · #{money.call(net_total)} · #{contract_id}", 'cro_token' => cro_token }
